name_de: Cube Reaction Hybrid ONE 720 Easy Entry
name_en: Cube Reaction Hybrid ONE 720 Easy Entry
description_de: Das Cube Reaction Hybrid ONE 720 Easy Entry ist ein E-Hardtail-Mountainbike von Cube. Der Antrieb (Bosch Performance Line CX) mit bis zu 120 Nm Drehmoment wird von einem 720-Wh-Akku gespeist. Federung: SR Suntour XCM32 LO-R Air, Tapered, 15x110mm, 100mm. Schaltung: Shimano Deore RD-M6200-SGS, ShadowPlus, 12-Speed. Bremsen: Shimano BR-MT200, Hydr. Disc Brake (180/180). Rahmen: Aluminium Superlite. Erhältlich in den Größen S, M, L, XL.
description_en: The Cube Reaction Hybrid ONE 720 Easy Entry is an electric hardtail mountain bike from Cube. The drive (Bosch Performance Line CX) with up to 120 Nm of torque is powered by a 720 Wh battery. Suspension: SR Suntour XCM32 LO-R Air, Tapered, 15x110mm, 100mm. Drivetrain: Shimano Deore RD-M6200-SGS, ShadowPlus, 12-Speed. Brakes: Shimano BR-MT200, Hydr. Disc Brake (180/180). Frame: Aluminium Superlite. Available in sizes S, M, L, XL.
